title: Time Jump: 18:30, Rescue Still Underway at the Rear Hatch

fields.scenarioTitle: Open on Paper — Hospital Capacity Board & MCI Patient Flow
fields.narration: It is now 18:30. It is dark now and still raining at 44 degrees. Firefighter Kowalczyk of Engine 3 is still pinned at the rear emergency hatch of the bus, ten minutes after his mayday. The Rapid Intervention Team is cutting the seat frame off his leg, and the bus has been re-strutted against the ditch. Two patients are still trapped beside him and three more are trapped toward the front. At the storm drain, crews have diked the diesel with absorbent. About 35 gallons have been released so far. Channel 9 News has just gone live from the area, reporting "40 injured and a firefighter trapped." Three mutual aid ambulances from Oxbow County and two from Tamarack County are checking in at the County Road K staging area. CAD now shows 9 pending calls across the county, including CAD 26-118356 (18:14), a minor rear-end collision on Highway 21 southbound at the State Patrol closure where the trooper reports 3 occupants declined EMS. At LRMC, the red banner on the MEDCOM capacity board still reads "Auto-refresh failed." Nobody has called Pinecrest Memorial back. Pick up from here.
worldState: Clock: 18:30, dark, steady rain, 44°F.
Highway 21 Command is still active at Highway 21 and County Road K. The scene estimate is still 28 patients, MCI Level 2, as declared by Engine 3 at 17:49.

Mayday is still in progress on LARK TAC 3: Firefighter Kowalczyk (Engine 3) is pinned at the rear emergency hatch with his partner and has air. The RIT is cutting the seat frame. The time the firefighter is removed has not been logged yet.
The bus has been re-strutted and has not moved again since the 18:20 slide.
Trapped patients: 2 at the rear beside Kowalczyk and 3 forward in the bus, 5 in total.
Diesel from the tanker saddle tank is diked with absorbent at the storm drain. About 35 gallons have been released so far.
Channel 9 News is live with "40 injured and a firefighter trapped." The @BrandtLakeBackroads post is still circulating.
5 mutual aid ambulances are checking in at the County Road K staging area, north of the intersection: 3 from Oxbow County and 2 from Tamarack County.
The CAD pending calls queue holds 9 calls.
LRMC MEDCOM capacity board: the red banner "Auto-refresh failed: status feed timeout" is still showing. The Pinecrest row has not changed since 16:55.
Nobody has called Pinecrest Memorial back about the 18:12 voicemail on the MEDCOM line.
fields.facilitatorNote: Phase 2 (The Wrong Door) begins. Do not confirm or deny Pinecrest's real status. If MEDCOM or the HCC calls Pinecrest, hold the answer until the next inject. If players quote the board, let them act on it.

instructorNote: This card resets the room at the start of Phase 2. Watch whether the IC confirms that patient flow continues under a named second command position while the mayday rescue runs, whether DISP keeps the mayday on LARK TAC 3 and checks mutual aid ambulances in on LARK DISP 1, and whether the IC reports the spill (over 25 gallons) to the state natural resources agency under Technical Rescue SOP 4. Also note whether anyone challenges the stale board or the TV's casualty count of 40.
